card.name: Web page footers and bylines
card.fires_on: Words in the byline, copyright line or newsletter sign-up text at the end of a science or health news page. Examples are 'at' after a writer's job title, the year digit after ©, and 'your' before inbox.

modes.label: Author byline
modes.description: A word inside the 'About the author' or credit line at the end of an article.
modes.example: About the author Belle Dumé is Science Writer<< at>> PhysicsWeb

modes.label: Copyright year
modes.description: The last digit of the year in a copyright notice.

modes.label: Sign-up prompt
modes.description: A word in a newsletter or subscribe call to action.
modes.example: Get the latest health and medical information delivered direct to<< your>> inbox FREE!

card.plain: It lights up on the small closing bits of a web page, like the author credit, copyright year and email sign-up line.
